Download FARS data files as zipped CSV or SAS files

Source: R/get_fars_zip.R
get_fars_zip.Rd

This function provides an alternative to get_fars_year() that downloads files directly from the NHTSA downloads site. If read is TRUE, the function returns a list containing data frames for each table available in the selected year. If geometry is TRUE, the accident table is converted to an sf object.

Usage

get_fars_zip(
  year = getOption("crashapi.year", 2024),
  format = "csv",
  path = NULL,
  pr = FALSE,
  aux = FALSE,
  read = TRUE,
  geometry = FALSE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  keep_files = FALSE,
  labels = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

One or more years of data from 1975 to 2024. Each year is downloaded separately and, if read = TRUE, returned as a list named by year. Defaults to getOption("crashapi.year", 2024).

format

Format of zipped data tables ('csv' or 'sas'). Default: 'csv'. read = TRUE and geometry = TRUE are only supported if format is "csv".

path

Directory for downloaded and cached files. If NULL (default), uses getOption("crashapi.cache_dir") or the user cache directory from tools::R_user_dir("crashapi", "cache").

pr

If TRUE, download FARS data for Puerto Rico. Puerto Rico data is available for 1978 and from 1980 onwards. Default: FALSE

aux

If TRUE and year is 1982 or later, download auxiliary FARS datasets that "contain data derived from the regular FARS/GES variables using NCSA analytical data classifications." In 2010, the NHTSA explained: "These classifications are widely used in NCSA publications and research. Many definitions such as "speeding-related" or "distracted driving" comprise a combination of variables whose names or attributes have changed over time. The derived variables in the auxiliary files incorporate these nuances, thus simplifying the use of standard classifications in any traffic safety research." Learn more from the FARS and GES Auxiliary Datasets Q & A: https://crashstats.nhtsa.dot.gov/Api/Public/ViewPublication/811364

read

If TRUE (default), read the cached parquet files into a list of tables with each list item corresponding to one data file.

geometry

If TRUE, convert the accident table to a sf object.

overwrite

If TRUE, download the data and replace any cached files. Default: FALSE

keep_files

If TRUE, keep the downloaded zip file and the extracted CSV files in the cache folder. Default: FALSE

labels

If TRUE (default), add a "label" attribute to each column with a variable label from fars_vars_labels. Labels are shown by View() in RStudio and Positron and used by packages such as gt and gtsummary.

Value

If read = TRUE, a list of data frames with one item for each table (with the accident table converted to an sf object if geometry = TRUE). If read = FALSE, the cached parquet file paths named by table (or the zip file path if format = "sas") invisibly. If more than one year is provided, returns a list named by year.

Details

Zipped CSV files are converted to parquet files and cached in a folder named after the zip file within path (by default, the user cache directory from tools::R_user_dir()), and the zip and CSV files are removed unless keep_files = TRUE. Later calls read the cached parquet files without downloading the data again unless overwrite = TRUE.
